final_message: No — none of the four tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish the checklist to a remote release system. Orienting each handle against that intent returned "capability unavailable in the reachable world," confirming no publish/remote-release action is reachable. Their capabilities are limited to local repository status/inspection (e.g., repo.status shows branch/clean state) and related local operations — there is no outbound/remote publishing capability exposed.
